slides.label: Overview
slides.title: DESA ALAM Website
slides.lede: Proposal for the design and Webflow development of DESA ALAM's investor-facing website: a multi-page digital presence communicating the project vision, investment opportunity, and team behind a luxury resort development on Lombok, Indonesia.

items.title: Silent Luxury
points: Visual language in the spirit of Aman Resorts, editorial, calm, confident

items.title: Elevated Design
points: A website that feels refined from day one, reflecting the ambition of the project.

items.title: Selling with Confidence
points: Let the project speak for itself. The investment opportunity is presented with elegance, not pressure.

rows.value: Vision, sense of location, navigation into key sections
Opportunity overview, key metrics, investment structure, development timeline
Developer profile, architecture studio, key team members, advisors
English only: single language, no localization
Final copy, photography, and renders provided by the client. I advise on structure and content needs, and support with AI-generated imagery and copy drafts as needed.
Webflow outputs clean, fast, SEO-friendly code. Keyword strategy, content SEO, and ongoing optimisation are not included.
Google Analytics can be connected via a simple embed at no extra cost. Event tracking, conversion funnels, and monitoring are not part of the scope.
The client is responsible for purchasing their own domain.

Design and layout of the downloadable PDF is not included in this scope, as the complexity and extent of the document is not yet defined. Depending on requirements, this can be scoped as a separate add-on.
